data.long_meaning: Name of French origin, derived from 'beau' meaning beautiful and 'camp' meaning field. This name was used in the Middle Ages and has been popular in France and England throughout history. The name Beauchamp carries the meaning “Beautiful field” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Beauchamp usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful field and live with faith, good character and purpose.
